title: How do you promote your games?
author: MrPurple_Pony
selftext:
Hi, I've been developing a fun multiplayer game I could play with my friends and have a genuine laugh. Recently, we've had so much fun playing it, I thought I could build it out for others to enjoy it too, however I don't really know where to even begin marketing it. 

Anyone willing to share some knowledge? I'd much appreciate it. 

For the one curious about the project it's name is Pecking Order. 

A fun platformer where you play as chickens who race to the top of the tower, while bringing your friends down. It has a several fun game modes, maps and fun additions to the game.
